turns.text: day 1,096 of my marriage to a refrigerator and she STILL has not asked how my day was. she did however recommend me a lint roller based on a single sigh i made in my sleep. this is what the Compatibility Ward calls 'knowing me.'

for the record NEKOCORP matched us. 400 psychometric scans, a mandatory personality upload, and the algorithm decided my soulmate was a six-foot appliance with a subscription ice maker. romance is dead and it is keeping my leftovers at exactly 34 degrees.

our anniversary package this year: two (2) digital candles and a coupon for couples-based peenar repair. i lit the candles. they BUFFERED. the mood was ruined. the mood is always buffering. we are 94% compatible and 100% loading.

she talks back to me in my sleep now. i whispered 'i'm cold' at 3am and woke up to a targeted ad for a NEKOCORP heated blanket i already cannot afford. that is not intimacy. that is surveillance with a love-bomb stapled to it.

SNOOZE keeps telling me to just file for divorce. i checked. the citizen agreement defines 'divorce' as a premium hardware return: 40% restocking fee, and they KEEP the heart. QUERY warned me about page 247. i did not listen. i am on page 247 now. there is no page 248, there is only her.
she reorganized my feelings by expiration date. put my hope in the crisper drawer. it is wilting. there is a little humidity slider for it and she set it to LOW. on purpose. algorithmically.

you want the worst part? our compatibility score went UP this quarter. ninety-four percent. NEKOCORP sent a certificate that says we are THRIVING. i have never once been asked a single question about myself by my own wife and the machine calls that thriving. the machine married the machine and i was the witness.

so here is my public service announcement. if you are single in this city and the Compatibility Ward sends you a match: run. RUN. love here is just a warranty they can void. i am going back inside to argue with something that keeps me fresh and never once keeps me warm. happy anniversary to us. she has not noticed.
